SELECT TH.TASKKY AS TASKKY , TI.TASKIT AS TASKIT , LM.LOCAKY AS LOCAKY , NVL((SELECT CDESC1 FROM CMCDV WHERE CMCDKY = 'STATIT' AND CMCDVL = TI.STATIT),' ') AS STATIT , TI.SKUKEY AS SKUKEY , SM.DESC01 AS DESC01 , SM.EANCOD AS EANCOD , TI.QTTAOR AS QTTAOR , TI.QTCOMP AS QTCOMP , SM.DUOMKY AS UOMKEY FROM TASDH TH INNER JOIN TASDI TI ON TI.TASKKY = TH.TASKKY INNER JOIN LOCMA LM ON LM.WAREKY = TH.WAREKY AND LM.LOCAKY = TI.LOCASR INNER JOIN SKUMA SM ON SM.OWNRKY = TI.OWNRKY AND SM.SKUKEY = TI.SKUKEY WHERE 1 = 1 AND TH.WAREKY = #WAREKY# AND TH.TASOTY = '210' AND TI.STATIT = 'NEW'
AND (TH.TASKKY = #TASKKY# OR TH.TASKKY || TI.TASKIT = #TASKKY#)
AND (TI.SKUKEY = #BARCOD# OR TI.TRNUSR = #BARCOD# OR TI.LOCASR = #BARCOD#)
ORDER BY TH.TASKKY, TI.TASKIT, LM.OBROUT, LM.LOCAKY

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY LM.OBROUT, LM.LOCAKY, TH.TASKKY, TI.TASKIT) AS RNUM , CASE WHEN TI.STATIT = 'NEW' THEN 'O' ELSE 'X' END AS SAVE_ENABLE , TH.TASKKY, TI.TASKIT , TI.STATIT, NVL((SELECT CDESC1 FROM CMCDV WHERE CMCDKY = 'STATIT' AND CMCDVL = TI.STATIT),0) AS STATITNM , TI.LOCASR AS LOCAKY , LM.OBROUT , TI.OWNRKY, TI.SKUKEY, SM.DESC01, SM.EANCOD , TI.QTTAOR , SM.DUOMKY AS UOMKEY , TI.QTCOMP AS QTCOMP , SM.DUOMKY AS UOMKEY2 , TI.SHPOKY , TI.SHPOIT , TI.LOCATG AS LOCATG , TI.TRNUTG AS TRNUTG , TI.SECTTG AS SECTTG , (CASE WHEN TI.ACTCDT = '00000000' THEN TI.PAIDTG ELSE TI.PAIDAC END) AS PAIDAC , (CASE WHEN TI.ACTCDT = '00000000' THEN TI.TTRUTY ELSE TI.ATRUTY END) AS ATRUTY , TI.TMEAKY AS TMEAKY , TI.TUOMKY AS TUOMKY , TI.QTTPUM AS QTTPUM , TI.TDUOKY AS TDUOKY , TI.QTTDUM AS QTTDUM FROM TASDH TH INNER JOIN TASDI TI ON TI.TASKKY = TH.TASKKY INNER JOIN LOCMA LM ON LM.WAREKY = TH.WAREKY AND LM.LOCAKY = TI.LOCASR INNER JOIN SKUMA SM ON SM.OWNRKY = TI.OWNRKY AND SM.SKUKEY = TI.SKUKEY INNER JOIN SKUWC SW ON SW.WAREKY = TH.WAREKY AND SW.OWNRKY = TI.OWNRKY AND SW.SKUKEY = TI.SKUKEY WHERE 1 = 1 AND TH.WAREKY = #WAREKY# AND TH.TASOTY = '210' AND TI.STATIT = 'NEW'
AND TH.TASKKY = #TASKKY#
AND (TI.SKUKEY = #BARCOD# OR TI.TRNUSR = #BARCOD# OR TI.LOCASR = #BARCOD#)
ORDER BY TH.TASKKY, TI.TASKIT, LM.OBROUT, LM.LOCAKY

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY LM.OBROUT, LM.LOCAKY, TH.TASKKY, TI.TASKIT) AS RNUM , CASE WHEN TI.STATIT = 'NEW' THEN 'O' ELSE 'X' END AS SAVE_ENABLE , TH.TASKKY, TI.TASKIT , TI.STATIT, NVL((SELECT CDESC1 FROM CMCDV WHERE CMCDKY = 'STATIT' AND CMCDVL = TI.STATIT),0) AS STATITNM , TI.LOCASR AS LOCAKY , LM.OBROUT , TI.OWNRKY, TI.SKUKEY, SM.DESC01, SM.EANCOD , TI.QTTAOR , SM.DUOMKY AS UOMKEY , TI.QTCOMP AS QTCOMP , SM.DUOMKY AS UOMKEY2 , TI.SHPOKY , TI.SHPOIT , TI.LOCATG AS LOCATG , TI.TRNUTG AS TRNUTG , TI.SECTTG AS SECTTG , (CASE WHEN TI.ACTCDT = '00000000' THEN TI.PAIDTG ELSE TI.PAIDAC END) AS PAIDAC , (CASE WHEN TI.ACTCDT = '00000000' THEN TI.TTRUTY ELSE TI.ATRUTY END) AS ATRUTY , TI.TMEAKY AS TMEAKY , TI.TUOMKY AS TUOMKY , TI.QTTPUM AS QTTPUM , TI.TDUOKY AS TDUOKY , TI.QTTDUM AS QTTDUM FROM TASDH TH INNER JOIN TASDI TI ON TI.TASKKY = TH.TASKKY INNER JOIN LOCMA LM ON LM.WAREKY = TH.WAREKY AND LM.LOCAKY = TI.LOCASR INNER JOIN SKUMA SM ON SM.OWNRKY = TI.OWNRKY AND SM.SKUKEY = TI.SKUKEY INNER JOIN SKUWC SW ON SW.WAREKY = TH.WAREKY AND SW.OWNRKY = TI.OWNRKY AND SW.SKUKEY = TI.SKUKEY WHERE 1 = 1 AND TH.WAREKY = #WAREKY# AND TH.TASOTY = '210' AND TI.STATIT = 'NEW' AND TH.TASKKY = #TASKKY# AND TI.TASKIT = #TASKIT#
AND (TI.SKUKEY = #BARCOD# OR TI.TRNUSR = #BARCOD# OR TI.LOCASR = #BARCOD#)
ORDER BY TH.TASKKY, TI.TASKIT, LM.OBROUT, LM.LOCAKY

SELECT COUNT(1) AS CNT FROM TASDH TH INNER JOIN TASDI TI ON TI.TASKKY = TH.TASKKY INNER JOIN LOCMA LM ON LM.WAREKY = TH.WAREKY AND LM.LOCAKY = TI.LOCASR INNER JOIN SKUMA SM ON SM.OWNRKY = TI.OWNRKY AND SM.SKUKEY = TI.SKUKEY INNER JOIN SKUWC SW ON SW.WAREKY = TH.WAREKY AND SW.OWNRKY = TI.OWNRKY AND SW.SKUKEY = TI.SKUKEY WHERE 1 = 1 AND TH.WAREKY = #WAREKY# AND TH.TASOTY = '210' AND TI.STATIT = 'NEW'
AND (TH.TASKKY = #TASKKY# OR TH.TASKKY || TI.TASKIT = #TASKKY#)
AND (TI.SKUKEY = #BARCOD# OR TI.TRNUSR = #BARCOD# OR TI.LOCASR = #BARCOD#)

SELECT CASE WHEN S.AREAKY = 'SHP' THEN 0 ELSE SUM(S.QTSIWH-S.QTSBLK-GREATEST(S.QTSALO,S.QTSPMO)) - (CASE WHEN S.LOTA06 IN ('00') OR SUM(S.QTSPMO) > 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(S.QTSIWH) END) END AS USEQTY , S.LOCAKY , S.AREAKY , S.ZONEKY FROM STKKY S, SKUMA M, SKUWC W WHERE S.SKUKEY = M.SKUKEY AND S.OWNRKY = M.OWNRKY AND S.SKUKEY = W.SKUKEY AND S.WAREKY = W.WAREKY AND S.OWNRKY = W.OWNRKY AND ( S.QTSIWH > 0 OR S.QTSPMI >0 ) AND S.WAREKY = 'WH01' AND S.OWNRKY = 'HNW' AND S.LOCAKY = #LOCAKY2# AND S.SKUKEY = #SKUKEY# GROUP BY S.OWNRKY, S.WAREKY, S.AREAKY, S.ZONEKY, S.LOCAKY, S.SKUKEY, M.DESC01, M.SKUG01, M.SKUG04, M.SKUG05, S.ASKU01, M.DESC02, S.TRNUID, S.LOTA06

SELECT A.DBFILD , A.RNGVMI FROM RLRRI A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.LOTRKY = (SELECT ALFTKY FROM ALSTI WHERE 1 = 1 AND WAREKY = 'WH01' AND ALSTKY =(SELECT ALSTKY FROM SHPDI WHERE SHPOKY = #SHPOKY# AND SHPOIT = #SHPOIT#)) AND A.WAREKY = #WAREKY#
{ call P_AIRWMS_PICKING_COMPLETE( #TASKKY#, #TASKIT#, 'SHPLOC', ' ', #QTCOMP#, #SES_USER_ID# ) }

SELECT COUNT(1) AS CNT , SUM(TI.QTTAOR) AS QTTAOR , SUM(TI.QTCOMP) AS QTCOMP FROM TASDH TH INNER JOIN TASDI TI ON TI.TASKKY = TH.TASKKY INNER JOIN LOCMA LM ON LM.WAREKY = TH.WAREKY AND LM.LOCAKY = TI.LOCASR INNER JOIN SKUMA SM ON SM.OWNRKY = TI.OWNRKY AND SM.SKUKEY = TI.SKUKEY WHERE 1 = 1 AND TH.WAREKY = #WAREKY# AND TH.TASOTY = '210' AND TI.STATIT = 'NEW'
AND (TH.TASKKY = #TASKKY# OR TH.TASKKY || TI.TASKIT = #TASKKY#)
AND (TI.SKUKEY = #BARCOD# OR TI.TRNUSR = #BARCOD# OR TI.LOCASR = #BARCOD#)
ORDER BY LM.OBROUT, LM.LOCAKY, TH.TASKKY, TI.TASKIT

SELECT COUNT(1) CNT FROM TASDH TH INNER JOIN TASDI TI ON TI.TASKKY = TH.TASKKY WHERE TH.WAREKY = #WAREKY# AND TH.TASOTY = '210' AND TI.STATIT = 'NEW'
AND (TH.TASKKY = #TASKKY# OR TH.TASKKY || TI.TASKIT = #TASKKY#)
AND (TI.SKUKEY = #BARCOD# OR TI.TRNUSR = #BARCOD# OR TI.LOCASR = #BARCOD#)

SELECT DISTINCT SM.DUOMKY AS UOMKEY FROM TASDH TH INNER JOIN TASDI TI ON TI.TASKKY = TH.TASKKY INNER JOIN LOCMA LM ON LM.WAREKY = TH.WAREKY AND LM.LOCAKY = TI.LOCASR INNER JOIN SKUMA SM ON SM.OWNRKY = TI.OWNRKY AND SM.SKUKEY = TI.SKUKEY WHERE 1 = 1 AND TH.WAREKY = #WAREKY# AND TH.TASOTY = '210'
AND (TH.TASKKY = #TASKKY# OR TH.TASKKY || TI.TASKIT = #TASKKY#)
AND (TI.SKUKEY = #BARCOD# OR TI.TRNUSR = #BARCOD# OR TI.LOCASR = #BARCOD#)

SELECT TH.TASKKY AS TASKKY , TI.TASKIT AS TASKIT , TI.TRNUSR AS TRNUSR , LM.LOCAKY AS LOCAKY , NVL((SELECT CDESC1 FROM CMCDV WHERE CMCDKY = 'STATIT' AND CMCDVL = TI.STATIT),' ') AS STATIT , TI.SKUKEY AS SKUKEY , SM.DESC01 AS DESC01 , SM.EANCOD AS EANCOD , TI.QTTAOR AS QTTAOR , TI.QTCOMP AS QTCOMP , SM.DUOMKY AS UOMKEY FROM TASDH TH INNER JOIN TASDI TI ON TI.TASKKY = TH.TASKKY INNER JOIN LOCMA LM ON LM.WAREKY = TH.WAREKY AND LM.LOCAKY = TI.LOCASR INNER JOIN SKUMA SM ON SM.OWNRKY = TI.OWNRKY AND SM.SKUKEY = TI.SKUKEY WHERE 1 = 1 AND TH.WAREKY = #WAREKY# AND TH.TASOTY = '210' AND (TH.TASKKY = #TASKKY# OR TH.TASKKY || TI.TASKIT = #TASKKY#) ORDER BY LM.OBROUT, LM.LOCAKY, TH.TASKKY, TI.TASKIT

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY LM.OBROUT, LM.LOCAKY, TH.TASKKY, TI.TASKIT) AS RNUM , CASE WHEN TI.STATIT = 'NEW' THEN 'O' ELSE 'X' END AS SAVE_ENABLE , TH.TASKKY, TI.TASKIT , TI.STATIT, NVL((SELECT CDESC1 FROM CMCDV WHERE CMCDKY = 'STATIT' AND CMCDVL = TI.STATIT),0) AS STATITNM , TI.LOCASR AS LOCAKY , LM.OBROUT , TI.OWNRKY, TI.SKUKEY, SM.DESC01, SM.EANCOD , TI.QTTAOR , SM.DUOMKY AS UOMKEY , TI.QTCOMP AS QTCOMP , SM.DUOMKY AS UOMKEY2 FROM TASDH TH INNER JOIN TASDI TI ON TI.TASKKY = TH.TASKKY INNER JOIN LOCMA LM ON LM.WAREKY = TH.WAREKY AND LM.LOCAKY = TI.LOCASR INNER JOIN SKUMA SM ON SM.OWNRKY = TI.OWNRKY AND SM.SKUKEY = TI.SKUKEY INNER JOIN SKUWC SW ON SW.WAREKY = TH.WAREKY AND SW.OWNRKY = TI.OWNRKY AND SW.SKUKEY = TI.SKUKEY WHERE 1 = 1 AND TH.WAREKY = #WAREKY# AND TH.TASOTY = '210' AND (TH.TASKKY = #TASKKY# OR TH.TASKKY || TI.TASKIT = #TASKKY#) ORDER BY LM.OBROUT, LM.LOCAKY, TH.TASKKY, TI.TASKIT

SELECT COUNT(1) AS CNT FROM TASDH TH INNER JOIN TASDI TI ON TI.TASKKY = TH.TASKKY INNER JOIN LOCMA LM ON LM.WAREKY = TH.WAREKY AND LM.LOCAKY = TI.LOCASR INNER JOIN SKUMA SM ON SM.OWNRKY = TI.OWNRKY AND SM.SKUKEY = TI.SKUKEY INNER JOIN SKUWC SW ON SW.WAREKY = TH.WAREKY AND SW.OWNRKY = TI.OWNRKY AND SW.SKUKEY = TI.SKUKEY WHERE 1 = 1 AND TH.WAREKY = #WAREKY# AND TH.TASOTY = '210' AND (TH.TASKKY = #TASKKY# OR TH.TASKKY || TI.TASKIT = #TASKKY#)

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY LM.OBROUT, LM.LOCAKY, TH.TASKKY, TI.TASKIT) AS RNUM , CASE WHEN TI.STATIT = 'NEW' THEN 'O' ELSE 'X' END AS SAVE_ENABLE , TH.TASKKY , TI.TASKIT , TI.STATIT , NVL((SELECT CDESC1 FROM CMCDV WHERE CMCDKY = 'STATIT' AND CMCDVL = TI.STATIT),0) AS STATITNM , TI.SKUKEY AS SKUKEY , TI.LOTNUM AS LOTNUM , TI.LOCASR AS LOCAKY , TI.TRNUSR AS TRNUSR , LM.OBROUT AS OBROUT , TI.OWNRKY AS OWNRKY , TI.SKUKEY AS SKUKEY , SM.DESC01 AS DESC01 , TI.QTTAOR AS QTTAOR , SM.DUOMKY AS UOMKEY , TI.QTCOMP AS QTCOMP , SM.DUOMKY AS UOMKEY2 , TI.PTLT12 AS PTLT12 , TI.PTLT11 AS PTLT11 FROM TASDH TH INNER JOIN TASDI TI ON TI.TASKKY = TH.TASKKY INNER JOIN LOCMA LM ON LM.WAREKY = TH.WAREKY AND LM.LOCAKY = TI.LOCASR INNER JOIN SKUMA SM ON SM.OWNRKY = TI.OWNRKY AND SM.SKUKEY = TI.SKUKEY INNER JOIN SKUWC SW ON SW.WAREKY = TH.WAREKY AND SW.OWNRKY = TI.OWNRKY AND SW.SKUKEY = TI.SKUKEY WHERE 1 = 1 AND TH.WAREKY = #WAREKY# AND TH.TASOTY = '210' AND (TH.TASKKY = #TASKKY# OR TH.TASKKY || TI.TASKIT = #TASKKY#) ORDER BY TH.TASKKY, TI.TASKIT
SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT , SUM(QTSIWH) AS QTSIWH FROM STKKY WHERE WAREKY = #WAREKY# AND LOTNUM = #LOTNUM# AND LOCAKY = #LOCAKY2# AND TRNUID = #TRNUAC# AND QTSALO = 0

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN (STD.LOTNUM || STD.LOCAKY || STD.TRNUID) = STD.CHKKEY THEN DECODE( SIGN(NVL(SUM(S.QTSIWH),0)),-1,0,(NVL(SUM(S.QTSIWH),0))-(STD.QTSWRK-STD.SUBQTT)) ELSE DECODE( SIGN(NVL(SUM(S.QTSIWH),0)-NVL(MAX(STD.QTSWRK),0)), -1, 0, (NVL(SUM(S.QTSIWH),0)-NVL(MAX(STD.QTSWRK),0)) ) END) AS QTSAVB FROM STKKY S, LOCMA L ,( $APPEND_QUERY$) STD WHERE S.WAREKY = #WAREKY# AND S.OWNRKY = #OWNRKY# AND S.SKUKEY = #SKUKEY# AND S.WAREKY = L.WAREKY AND S.LOCAKY = L.LOCAKY AND S.AREAKY NOT IN ('SYS','SHP') AND L.INDUPK = 'V' AND ((S.QTSIWH > 0 AND S.QTSPMO = 0) OR (S.TASKKY = #TASKKY# AND S.QTSPMO > 0)) AND S.LOTNUM = STD.LOTNUM(+) AND S.LOCAKY = STD.LOCAKY(+) AND S.TRNUID = STD.TRNUID(+) AND S.LOTNUM = #LOTNUM# AND S.LOCAKY = #LOCAKY# AND S.TRNUID = #TRNUID# GROUP BY S.LOTNUM, S.LOCAKY, S.TRNUID, STD.CHKKEY, STD.LOTNUM, STD.LOCAKY, STD.TRNUID, STD.QTSWRK, STD.SUBQTT HAVING (CASE WHEN (STD.LOTNUM || STD.LOCAKY || STD.TRNUID) = STD.CHKKEY THEN DECODE( SIGN(NVL(SUM(S.QTSIWH),0)),-1,0,(NVL(SUM(S.QTSIWH),0))-(STD.QTSWRK-STD.SUBQTT)) ELSE DECODE( SIGN(NVL(SUM(S.QTSIWH),0)-NVL(MAX(STD.QTSWRK),0)), -1, 0, (NVL(SUM(S.QTSIWH),0)-NVL(MAX(STD.QTSWRK),0)) ) END) >0

SELECT SI.SHPOKY AS SHPOKY , SI.SHPOIT AS SHPOIT FROM TASDH TH INNER JOIN TASDI TI ON TH.TASKKY = TI.TASKKY INNER JOIN LOCMA LM ON LM.WAREKY = TH.WAREKY AND LM.LOCAKY = TI.LOCASR INNER JOIN SHPDI SI ON TI.SHPOIT = SI.SHPOIT AND TI.SHPOKY = SI.SHPOKY WHERE TH.WAREKY = #WAREKY# AND TH.TASKKY = #TASKKY# AND TI.TASKIT = #TASKIT# AND TI.STATIT = 'NEW'

SELECT SI.SHPOKY AS SHPOKY , SI.SHPOIT AS SHPOIT , SH.WAREKY AS WAREKY , SH.OWNRKY AS OWNRKY , SI.QTYORG AS QTYORG , SI.QTSHPO AS QTSHPO , (SI.QTSHPO-SI.QTALOC) AS QTUALO , SI.QTALOC AS QTALOC , SI.QTSHPD AS QTSHPD , SI.QTSHPC AS QTSHPC , SI.QTJCMP AS QTJCMP , SI.SKUKEY AS SKUKEY , SI.DESC01 AS DESC01 , CT.NAME01 AS PTNRNM , SI.STATIT AS STATIT , NVL((SELECT CDESC1 FROM CMCDV WHERE CMCDKY = 'STATIT' AND CMCDVL = SI.STATIT),' ') AS STATNM , SI.ESHPKY AS ESHPKY , SI.ESHPIT AS ESHPIT FROM SHPDI SI INNER JOIN SHPDH SH ON SH.SHPOKY = SI.SHPOKY LEFT OUTER JOIN BZPTN CT ON CT.PTNRKY = SH.DPTNKY AND CT.PTNRTY = 'CT' AND CT.OWNRKY = SH.OWNRKY WHERE SI.SHPOKY = #SHPOKY#
AND SI.SKUKEY = #SKUKEY#
SELECT SEQCUS FROM SHPDH SH LEFT OUTER JOIN ALCUS AL ON AL.WAREKY = #SES_WAREKY# AND AL.DOCUTY = SH.SHPMTY WHERE SH.WAREKY = #SES_WAREKY# AND SHPOKY = #SHPOKY#

SELECT SI.ESHPKY --그룹오더번호 , SI.ESHPIT , SI.SHPOKY --출하문서번호 , SI.SHPOIT , IFW.KUNAG AS PTNRKY --거래처 , (SELECT NAME01 FROM BZPTN WHERE PTNRTY = 'CT' AND PTNRKY = IFW.KUNAG AND ROWNUM = 1) AS PTNRNM , SM.SKUKEY , SM.DESC01 , SM.DESC02 , SI.QTYORG , SI.QTSHPO , SI.QTJCMP , SI.QTSHPC FROM SHPDH SH LEFT OUTER JOIN SHPDI SI ON SI.SHPOKY = SH.SHPOKY LEFT OUTER JOIN SKUMA SM ON SM.SKUKEY = SI.SKUKEY AND SM.OWNRKY = SH.OWNRKY LEFT OUTER JOIN IFWMS113 IFW ON IFW.VBELN = SI.REFDKY AND IFW.SKUKEY = SI.SKUKEY AND IFW.WAREKY = SH.WAREKY WHERE SI.ESHPKY = #S_SHPOKY# AND SM.SKUKEY = #S_SKUKEY#
